newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul large-cap shrs seen falling in consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul large-cap shrs seen falling in consolidation.

text.p: Large-capitalised stocks are expected to fall on Monday on consolidation following recent sharp rises based on economic recovery hopes, brokers said.
"A consolidation is expected to prevail in the overall market, especially among large-cap stocks," said Chang Kun-woo of Daishin Securities.
But brokers saw buying in undervalued smaller-capitalised stocks would limit the market's decline.
The composite index last closed at 762.77 points on Saturday, down 2.90 points on the day.
Falling interest rates will also keep overall investor sentiment buoyant, brokers said.
Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed seven basis points lower at 11.45 percent on Saturday.
